label: Reportable to RBI
hint: RBI-regulated entities (banks, NBFCs, payment system operators, payment aggregators) report cyber incidents within 6 hours of detection.

label: Reportable to SEBI
hint: SEBI-regulated entities report cyber incidents to SEBI within 6 hours under CSCRF.

label: Reportable to IRDAI
hint: Insurers and intermediaries copy their CERT-In report to IRDAI within 6 hours.

label: Reportable to IFSCA
hint: IFSCA-regulated entities in GIFT City report within 6 hours, then an interim report in 3 days and a root cause analysis in 30 days.
